_README: REFERENCE ONLY — do not translate from this file.
This is the complete inventory of every English string in the repos the sim loads (756 total).
Most of it is shared PhET library text for features this sim never displays, so the actual
translation workbook is narrowed to the 191 strings that really appear:
Kept so you can see the full picture / recover anything missed.

histogramBinsPreferenceDescription.en: The histogram can represent data based on the width of the bins or by the total number of bins on the field.

showStandardErrorPreferenceDescription.en: Determines whether the standard error of the mean is displayed when Values is selected on the Measures screen.

launchSoundPreferenceDescription.en: The launch sound can represent either the initial speed or initial angle of the projectile, or it can be turned off.

playLandingSoundPreferenceDescription.en: Determines whether a sound is played when a projectile lands.

autoGenerateDataPreferenceDescription.en: Makes it so the launch button generates a full set of data.

projectileTypeAffectsSpeedPreferenceDesc.en: Determines whether the type of projectile affects its mean launch speed.
